messages:
elaine: quick sync — we need to land RBAC + sharing for the new runtime metrics dashboards before Dedicated alpha. thinking two separate surfaces: internal (full telemetry) and customer (masked/aggregated). audit trail required. prefer short feedback first.

rick: 👍 on split views. question: do we treat 'customer' dashboards as separate resources or views on same resource? implementation affects sharing semantics.

maya: runtime side: we can easily emit aggregated histograms (p50/p95/p99, batch sizes, queue depth). we can't surface raw request payloads or token-level debug traces to customers. sampling + aggregation only.

adil: audit requirements: every grant/revoke/share event must be emitted to our event-log with actor, target, action, prior_permissions, and request_id. retention 12 months (legal asked). also need an endpoint to export those events for compliance.

sasha: security: enforce least privilege. disallow public share-links for customer-facing dashboards by default. org-admins can opt-in. require MFA for org-wide grants. stripe down PII in any customer view (no request ids that correlate to user ids).

tory: from analytics: we need per-route cost breakdown and tokens/minute. for customers expose a cost_estimate metric, not raw internal unit price. aggregation windows: 1m and 1h.

elaine: UX question: share link vs role-based access. product leaning to share-links for debugging with partners, but security pushback is strong. can we make a time-limited link?

sasha: time-limited links OK if ephemeral and revocable plus audit logged. default off for customer-facing.

rick: implementation sketch: add visibility enum on dashboard resource: private, org, customer_link. enforce checks in console + API gateway and in tracing middleware. middleware should redact fields flagged by schema.

maya: note: streaming latency traces include connection ids — must scrub or hash before attaching to customer dashboards. use existing redact service.

adil: ops note: we already emit events topic:dashboard.events. will add types:share/grant/revoke with payload {actor, target, before, after, ts}. need schema change PR.

elaine: can we agree on the customer-safe field whitelist now so product can mock UI? list a minimal set and mark sensitive ones.

rick: proposed customer-safe whitelist: ["model_name", "region", "p50_latency_ms", "p95_latency_ms", "throughput_rps", "batch_size_median", "error_rate_pct", "cost_estimate_per_hour"]. sensitive: request_id, raw_prompt, kv_cache_dump, debug_stack.

maya: +1 but add "queue_depth_percentile" and ensure histograms are binned and non-invertible.

elaine: perfect. next: sharing UX states: draft, private, org_shared, time_limited_link. default = private for customer dashboards. product will mock flows.

sasha: add policy: when moving dashboard from private->org_shared, require two-step approval for orgs with >50 seats. enforce in API.

rick: will open an RFC with API contract and RBAC check locations. rough TODOs: 1) API visibility flag, 2) policy enforcement points, 3) audit events schema change, 4) console UX mocks, 5) telemetry redaction integration.

adil: tagging for incidents: if a share event is later associated with a data leak, we need ability to query who had access at a point-in-time. include prior_permissions in audit events.

elaine: timeline: want PRs for mocks + API contract by EOW. engineering blockers?

maya: infra: we'll need 2 days to add redaction hook and tests. might poke runtime owners for sampling defaults.

rick: platform: API checks + db migration for visibility flag — estimate 3d. audit-bot: will seed events topic stub.

audit-bot: notice: created placeholder topic dashboard.share.events (internal) — messages will be produced after schema PR merged. :robot_face:

elaine: thanks all. i'll draft the RFC with the whitelist and flows and tag you. if any objections to defaults (private + no public links) call now.

sasha: no objections. strongly prefer private default.

tory: ok from analytics side.

adil: fine from ops.

elaine: cool — moving forward.
